title: Painting Main Street at Port Jeff
content: This is the view looking across E. Main from the library in Port Jefferson, New York.I've already had one guy park in front of me, so I hold the parking space open with a traffic cone.I  love the shopfront with its big glass windows, awning, and the upstairs residence, all set against the cool grey-blue of the far building in shadow.I use a limited palette to focus only on the warm/cool dynamic.Titanium whiteUltramarine blueSepiaTransparent orange iron oxideYellow ochrePyrrol Red
